name: Ticket Router SLM
headline: Auto-route inbound support tickets to the right team in <100ms.
description: A multi-class classification template for customer-support orgs. Train a small model to read an incoming ticket and tag it with one of 5 destinations: billing, technical, account, sales, legal. Targets sub-100ms inference on mobile-cpu hardware so it can run on the support gateway without a GPU round-trip. Use case: SaaS support inboxes, e-commerce post-purchase queues, internal IT helpdesks.
suggested_brief: Train a 5-way ticket-routing classifier (billing / technical / account / sales / legal) for our SaaS support inbox. Macro-F1 above 0.85 is the bar. Must run sub-100ms on a single CPU core because it lives in the support gateway.
